stem: Which group of lines from the poem “An Unexpected Gift” contains a SIMILAR idea?
instruction:
Read the sentence from the article “Sticking to It.”

Although Silver missed his initial goal, he knew he designed something revolutionary. (paragraph 4)

options.label: A
options.text: Just then, a group of birds came down / upon my boat where it sat resting. (lines 29–30)

options.label: B
options.text: To our surprise (and my delight), / they seemed to find it interesting! (lines 31–32)

options.label: C
options.text: My cardboard boat, I recognized, / was never made to race and ride, / but even so it had a role— / For the birds it could provide! (lines 33–36)

options.label: D
options.text: My boat became a backyard fixture / not on our pond but in our tree; / there it sits steady, offering / a tasty treasure of bird seed. (lines 37–40)

visual_elements: sentence from article in box: "Although Silver missed his initial goal, he knew he designed something revolutionary. (paragraph 4)"
